services.name: Civic Conservatory
services.desc: The Civic Conservatory is Mid City Civic Theatre's youth training program, created to inspire, train, and mentor middle and high school students through meaningful theatrical experiences. More than acting classes, the Conservatory introduces students to every aspect of theatre, from performance and stage management to lighting, sound, costumes, scenic design, and production. Working alongside experienced artists and educators, students gain practical skills while building confidence, creativity, collaboration, and leadership. We believe theatre changes lives. It teaches young people how to communicate, solve problems, work as a team, and see the world through someone else's perspective.

blurb: Community theatre has been part of Baton Rouge's cultural fabric since 1946, when a group of local arts advocates came together with a shared vision of bringing quality live theatre to the capital region. That vision evolved into Baton Rouge Little Theater in 1951, later known as Theatre Baton Rouge, which became one of Louisiana's longest-running community theatres.
